english.note: Use 草 as the all-purpose noun for grass, including plants that merely look like grass; in drug slang it also means marijuana.

examples.english: I can smell grass in this room.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 man4 dou2 ni1 gaan1 fong2 jau5 cou2 mei6

english.note: Use this colloquial slang term for cannabis in casual drug-related conversation rather than for an unwanted plant.

examples.english: They said they have weed tonight and asked if I wanted to smoke some.
examples.traditional: 佢話今晚有草，問我去唔去食。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 gam1 maan1 jau5 cou2 man6 ngo5 heoi3 m4 heoi3 sik6
